k6_T300_control._note: the no-restore CONTROL. Extracted from s_k6_T300.cir, which for k=6 (one segment) is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the chain deck c_k6 would have been: with S=1 the inter-segment gap tres does not enter the schedule at all. The pre-patch driver skipped the redundant re-run because the control's single restoring stage is a trailing LOAD on bank 6 that feeds nothing and cannot resolve bank 6's collapsed output, so it had no latency to measure.

k1_T300_zcs._note: AMENDMENT A6: hop zeros re-probed per structural class on a three-segment deck and mapped A,B,B,B,B,C, because the one-segment transfer failed acceptance A4 per hop.

k1_T300_zcs2._note: AMENDMENT A6b: hop zeros = A6's three-class probe plus a MEASURED dI/dt slope correction on hops 3-5 (-I_zcs/(dI/dt), dI/dt least-squares fitted to I(L) over the 6 ps before each switch's own opening instant, MEASURED -40.72 uA/ps). No analytic zero is used anywhere.
